classification: CAE/5220 is the player-identified finish of a five-hit light attack string. Its weapon remains unclassified, so no sword import or choice is offered. It is not Flying Swallow.
shared_source: Immutable mixed source packages shared by sword strings C/D and C79. Native resource constructors and hash identities require whole actions, timing, motion and camera containers. Non-sword metadata and selections are excluded; repacking binary resources is unsupported.
sequence_policy: A filtered recording breaks at removed action identities. Source IDs and animation similarity alone do not establish duplication or a combo.
